title: Checkout API latency spike
description: Customers are seeing elevated latency and intermittent 502 responses during checkout.

timeline.event: Latency alert fired for checkout-api p95 above 2 seconds.
On-call engineer observed increased database connection wait time.

suspected_cause: Database connection pool saturation after a traffic increase.
customer_impact: Some users cannot complete checkout on the first attempt.

title: Notification delivery backlog
description: Email and SMS notifications are delayed because worker queue depth is increasing.

timeline.event: Autoscaling added workers but backlog continued to grow.

customer_impact: Time-sensitive account notifications may arrive late.
